_comment: Tier-2 for sparta hypersonic_flow:6, executed on the installed binary (SPARTA 24 Sep 2025, spa_serial). Six decks, all the same 2d argon slab with periodic x faces and diffuse-walled y faces. 'compute cb boundary all all etot' — the group-then-mixture habit carried over from compute grid / compute surf — gives 'ERROR: Illegal compute boundary command (../compute_boundary.cpp:64)', because arg[2] is the MIXTURE and there is no group slot. 'compute cb boundary gas etot' fed to fix ave/time WITHOUT 'mode vector' gives 'ERROR: Fix ave/time compute does not calculate a scalar (../fix_ave_time.cpp:137)' — it is a global ARRAY. With 'mode vector' it works, and the ROW ORDER is checked structurally rather than against remembered numbers: rows 1 and 2 (xlo, xhi) tally exactly zero for the whole run because those faces are periodic, while rows 3 and 4 (ylo, yhi) do not, which is what an order of xlo, xhi, ylo, yhi means and what any other order would break. A fifth row does not exist in 2d ('ERROR: Stats fix vector is accessed out-of-range (../stats.cpp:710)', printed by the run and echoed rather than asserted as a literal), and with two compute values the fix becomes a face-by-value array indexed f_ID[face][value]. COVERS: hypersonic_flow:6. MUTATION CONTROL (T2_MUTATE=1, re-runnable): the x faces become OUTFLOW instead of periodic — the single edit that makes those two rows carry traffic — with the y walls, the mixture, the density, the seed, the timestep and the run length untouched. Rows 1 and 2 stop being identically zero. Verified: unmutated the fixture PASSES (rc=0); with T2_MUTATE=1 it FAILS (rc=1) and this expect_in_output string goes False and disappears: the_first_two_rows_are_the_periodic_x_faces=True. The argument-shape assertions run on decks the hook does not touch and rest on verbatim messages carrying their own (file:line). Re-verify: cd scripts/tier2_fixtures/sparta/boundary_compute_takes_a_mixture_not_a_group && python source.py (passes, rc=0), then T2_MUTATE=1 python source.py (fails, rc=1). Needs a SPARTA binary: the fixtures find spa_serial/spa_mpi on PATH or at ~/Schreibtisch/sparta/src/spa_serial, else set SPARTA_BINARY; with none present they exit 0 on a SKIP: line, which forbid_in_output turns into a failure.
